root.label: Rebecca Cooke sends cease-and-desist letter to Derrick Van Orden over AI ads

events.label: Rebecca Cooke sends cease-and-desist letter to Derrick Van Orden over AI ads

slots.name: cease and desist status
slots.sentence: “Not only are these ads beneath the dignity of your office, but Wisconsin’s common law of defamation fills the gaps yet remaining in Wisconsin’s statutory protections against fake AI videos,” reads the letter, which Cooke shared on social media.
